scope: 44 missing non-UK map identities reconciled with 2,985 live public event identities. Research focus: Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, United States. Canada/South Africa delegated; remaining countries are outstanding.
publicationPolicy: PublishReady items have verified regular schedules, including Coffs Creek’s explicit firsthand event-director interview accepted by the parent reviewer. Generated weekly dates remain subject to cancellation; they are not individually guaranteed. No unverified start time or provisional launch is promoted.

map.evidenceSummary: Official country domain, event identifier, canonical slug, series identifier, name, venue and coordinates. Presence confirms a published venue identity, not its launch date or schedule.

ie_official.evidenceSummary: parkrun Ireland confirms the October return of Castletown after its 2023 pause, and launches of Cork Harbour Greenway, Corkagh junior and Dungarvan Greenway. A shared post by territory manager Jenny Branigan describes Irish 5k parkruns as Saturdays at 09:30.
ie_official.limitations: Relative social dates are not used to determine exact inaugural dates. The national 5k timing statement is not applied to juniors.

castletown_hub.evidenceSummary: The Celbridge hub lists Castletown, County Kildare, 5km and 09:30.
castletown_hub.limitations: Historical 2023/2024 campaign page; corroboration only. Current activity is established by official parkrun Ireland.

castletown_restart.evidenceSummary: 12 October podcast describes attending the Castletown restart on 10 October 2026.
castletown_restart.limitations: Independent participant report, not the event organiser; exact date retained as a lead.

waterford_launch.evidenceSummary: Sport Ireland local partnership announces the Dungarvan Greenway October launch, with weekly Saturday 09:30 starts at the Railway Cottage. Modified 27 August 2026.

waterford_format.evidenceSummary: Partner explains the 5k Saturday and 2k Sunday formats.
waterford_format.limitations: January 2025 page; contains an erroneous 2014 origin date, which must not be reused. It predates the new adult Dungarvan event.

dungarvan_report.evidenceSummary: Reports adult Dungarvan Greenway inaugural 17 October 2026 and 5km out-and-back route at Ballinroad.
dungarvan_report.limitations: Launch date is a secondary lead, not needed to create future regular fixtures.

cork_partner.evidenceSummary: Cork Sports Partnership current event list includes Cork Harbour Greenway, Carrigaline among its adult events and describes the adult format as 5km. Its FAQ expressly states all listed events start at 09:30 (search-confirmed turn161search3).

cork_launch_release.evidenceSummary: 21 October coverage with Vhi and parkrun Ireland named statements gives first event 17 October 2026, weekly Saturdays 09:30 and 5km at Carrigaline.
cork_launch_release.limitations: Hosted by a newspaper, corroborated by parkrun Ireland and its delivery partner.

south_dublin.evidenceSummary: Council confirms adult Corkagh 5k Saturday 09:30 and Griffeen junior 2k Sunday 09:30, but does not list new Corkagh junior.
south_dublin.limitations: Do not transfer Griffeen junior time to Corkagh junior.

junior_tracker.evidenceSummary: Tracker reports Corkagh junior launch 18 October, Forge Field junior 25 October, and provisional Mary Kinross junior 8 November after a test event.
junior_tracker.limitations: Discovery only. Neither the tracker nor its mirror is an official schedule or launch confirmation.

forge_directory.evidenceSummary: Forge Field junior appears with Sunday 09:00 and dates preceding its reported launch.
forge_directory.limitations: Unreliable recurrence defaults; other known Irish 09:30 juniors also appear as 09:00 on this directory. Do not publish this time.

narrogin_tourism.evidenceSummary: Narrogin tourism lists the specific Old Golf Course event as free weekly 5km, every Saturday 08:00, Earl Street, Narrogin WA 6312.
narrogin_tourism.limitations: Search index accessible; one direct open of the shorter alias URL timed out. No exact launch date is asserted from this page.

au_official.evidenceSummary: Official Australia page confirms Coffs Creek launch and the subsequent launches of JC Slaughter Falls and Nijong Oval. It defines Saturday events as 5k and Sunday juniors as 2k.
au_official.limitations: No venue start times. Relative post dates are not used alone to derive launch dates.

coffs_creek_interview.evidenceSummary: 23 October local newspaper interviews event director Keelan Birch about Coffs Creek: inaugural 24 October 2026, then weekly Saturday 07:00, 5km from Coffs Harbour Showground. It explicitly distinguishes the new event from Park Beach Reserve and Bongil Bongil.
coffs_creek_interview.limitations: Direct organiser interview hosted in local newspaper, not on the parkrun domain.

coffs_council.evidenceSummary: Council notice licenses community land at Coffs Creek to parkrun Australia for Saturday morning organised running. Submission deadline 15 October 2026.
coffs_council.limitations: Does not itself establish the local start time.

coffs_existing_health.evidenceSummary: NSW Health listing links the exact Coffs Harbour parkrun website and organiser email, identifies Park Beach Reserve, 5km and weekly Saturdays 07:00.
coffs_existing_health.limitations: Page has no dated schedule revision. Some unrelated milestone-shirt text is outdated and must not be reused.

au_nz_launch_podcast.evidenceSummary: Reports Narrogin inaugural 12 September, Moot Yang Gunya 26 September; Endeavour, Sunnynook and Queen Elizabeth Kapiti 3 October 2026. Describes Endeavour as the successor to Nathan Road.
au_nz_launch_podcast.limitations: Secondary discovery for dates/alias; not primary start-time verification.

endeavour_directory.evidenceSummary: Lists Endeavour Park, Endeavour Esplanade, Newport Queensland 4020, Saturdays 07:00, 5km.

moot_directory.evidenceSummary: Lists Mundulla Showgrounds/Kennedy Street, South Australia 5270; Saturdays 08:00 and 5km.

moot_news.evidenceSummary: 30 September report covers Mundulla inaugural with 58 participants.

cabarita_council.evidenceSummary: 21 April agenda describes approved six-month Cabarita trial: 5km, Saturdays 08:00, western Cabarita Park to Breakfast Point, two loops. Start remained contingent on fundraising.
cabarita_council.limitations: Proposal/approval evidence, not confirmation that launch conditions were satisfied. Latest start date must be established.

new5k_tracker.evidenceSummary: Tracker reports 31 October launches at Gums Loop, Nijong Oval, JC Slaughter Falls and Jurong Lake Gardens; planned 7 November Historic Kopu Bridge and Cabarita; 14 November Larkspur Landing; 21 November Provo.
new5k_tracker.limitations: Discovery only; map presence and tracker dates do not prove an event has begun.

nz_launch_stats.evidenceSummary: 4 October report lists Sunnynook and Queen Elizabeth Kapiti Coast launches on 3 October.

nz_new_directory.evidenceSummary: Lists recent New Zealand venues at Saturdays 08:00.
nz_new_directory.limitations: Automated directory; not a primary confirmation of actual local schedules or first dates.

waitangi_venue.evidenceSummary: Waitangi Mountain Bike Park cafe operator advertisement mentions launch of a free weekly 5km parkrun on 17 October 2026.
waitangi_venue.limitations: No start time; operator attribution needs primary-site corroboration.

linklater_posts.evidenceSummary: Mirror of founding-team posts dated 21–24 October states 24 October inaugural, weekly Saturday 08:00, 5km; first-timers briefing 07:50. Identifies directors Wendy and Karen and links the new official Facebook page.
linklater_posts.limitations: Primary Facebook page is unavailable to retrieval; strong specific organiser-material lead, but reproduced by an independent mirror.

linklater_facebook.evidenceSummary: Canonical official Facebook page linked in founding-team post.
linklater_facebook.limitations: Web open returned DisabledError. No session or access-control bypass attempted.

kopu_trial.evidenceSummary: Kendall Todd and Chris Kemp discuss the 5 September test run across Historic Kopu Bridge and plans for an official launch later in 2026.
kopu_trial.limitations: Confirms a test event, not the formal launch or weekly start time.

kopu_venue.evidenceSummary: Historic bridge site directs readers to its Facebook page for upcoming events.

provo_organiser.evidenceSummary: Organising Roadrunner Club explicitly states 5km every Saturday at Delta Gateway Park, 311 N Lakeshore Drive, Provo; practice starts 17 October, official launch 21 November 2026. Local starts are 09:00 November–April and 08:00 May–October.

larkspur_directory.evidenceSummary: Lists Larkspur Landing 5km every Saturday 09:00, but also advertises 24 October before reported launch.
larkspur_directory.limitations: Not acceptable to establish first date; primary local schedule still unverified.

sg_poster.evidenceSummary: Current official Singapore event-poster resource is explicitly titled 7.30am start.
sg_poster.limitations: National collateral template does not independently name or confirm all six local schedules.

sg_government.evidenceSummary: Team Nila volunteer opportunity explicitly names East Coast Park, Bishan and West Coast Park and gives a free 5km every Saturday at 07:30.
sg_government.limitations: Volunteer shift dates on the page are from 2019. Combined with current official 07:30 poster, strong correction evidence for those three, not a fresh cancellation check.

sg_bay_posts.evidenceSummary: Reproduced 11 September 2026 event-team announcement gives Bay East Garden 5km start 07:30, briefing 07:20, 11 Rhu Cross under Sheares Bridge.
sg_bay_posts.limitations: Independent mirror, not primary direct retrieval. No current November cancellation status established.

sg_bedok_posts.evidenceSummary: Reproduced event-team profile and 23 October 2026 post state Bedok Reservoir Saturdays 07:30; 1 November report describes its 100th event.
sg_bedok_posts.limitations: Independent mirror, not primary direct retrieval. Search excerpt accessible; no current November cancellation status established.

jurong_linktree.evidenceSummary: Jurong Lake Gardens parkrun link hub was created October 2026 and links a volunteer roster and official apps.

jurong_directory.evidenceSummary: Lists Jurong Lake Gardens Saturdays 07:30 including 7 November 2026.
jurong_directory.limitations: Primary local schedule not accessible; cannot establish dates by directory recurrence alone.

cancel_policy.evidenceSummary: 22 October policy says recurring events may cancel for safety, course availability, AED or volunteer issues. Decisions appear on event home/news pages, roster and social pages.

cancel_mirror.evidenceSummary: Current third-party cancellation overview searched; no named cancellation found for the primary-ready candidate set.
cancel_mirror.limitations: Absence from this secondary overview is not confirmation that a particular fixture will proceed.
